the Health Sync contract C2 builds on is still served read-only (v1.0)

tests.reason: C2 adds no route and no consumer: services/wellness-context is a library that nothing in src imports yet (the boundary test pins an empty importer allowlist), WELLNESS_CONTEXT_ENABLED is set on no task definition and isWellnessContextEnabled() is false whenever VITANA_ENV=staging, so there is nothing on staging to probe beyond the deployed commit. Its behaviour is proven by Jest over A's S10 fake (the real S3/S4 store logic in memory): disabled with the flag off, consent_required without ai_health_analysis with A's read port not called, empty on STORE_PENDING/STORE_DISABLED/empty rows without a throw, a withdrawn sync_sleep removing the sleep fact, only WellnessFactKind values, the two comparison functions (direction, minimum data), the prompt always locale-wrapped in all 11 locales. The purpose-boundary scans (no importers, no commerce or provider-SDK import, store tables only inside services/health-store, the legacy-reader ratchet, no condition names in 11 locales) and the extended VTID-05025 commerce scan are source scans and run in the gateway Jest CI job.
